For visits to mental health providers with private insurance as the primary source of payment, only 21.7 percent took place via telehealth for patients living outside of metropolitan areas compared to 53.4 percent for patients living in metropolitan areas.

For visits to mental health providers with Medicaid as the primary payer, only 14.8 percent took place via telehealth for patients in nonmetropolitan areas compared to nearly one-third (32.7%) for patients living in metropolitan areas.
